description: The credit packs both clients sell and the server grants. src/lib/pricing.ts builds the web pricing list and the server's plan map from this file, so a Razorpay order and a store purchase settle the credits and amount written here; ugc-mobile/lib/pricing.ts keeps a copy that a mobile test holds equal to it, because Metro cannot load a file from outside the app. priceInr is the web's charge in rupees and the mobile ledger's nominal amount, and it must match the store catalog seeded in supabase/migrations/20260714113000_harden_mobile_purchase_authority.sql. badge is the label of the pack both clients feature, or null.
